correctness.rationale: The nonlinear equation is rewritten with the exact factorization P_q(D)=product_{j=0}^3(D-eta+j). The phase multiplier 1 follows by differentiation. The scaling multiplier e^T is verified directly by substituting v=e^t(w'-eta w) into the variational operator and using 4+(q-1)eta=0. The reflection P_q(z)=P_q(-sigma-z), sigma=(3q+5)/(q-1), gives L*=e^{sigma t}Le^{-sigma t}; periodic-adjoint monodromy has reciprocal spectrum, forcing the two remaining multipliers. The four values are distinct for q>1, so there are no hidden multiplicities. No finite computation is used as proof.

value.rationale: The result resolves the spectral half of an explicit long-standing conjecture conditional on orbit existence and replaces profile-specific Floquet numerics with a profile-independent exact theorem. It also shows automatically that every nonconstant periodic profile, whenever it exists, has the same hyperbolic index. This is a structural statement about the blow-up mechanism, not a routine numerical refinement.
